recognize_zh: 腦組織切片中大型異型淋巴細胞呈血管周圍套袖狀（perivascular cuffing）聚集，網狀纖維染色（reticulin）在血管周圍形成同心圓層狀；IHC 為 CD20+、CD10−、BCL6+、MUM1+ 的非生發中心型，符合原發性中樞神經 DLBCL。
features: Diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular to coarse chromatin, prominent nucleoli and irregular nuclear contours
Striking angiocentric growth with tumor cells cuffing and infiltrating vessel walls (perivascular cuffing)
Numerous mitoses and apoptotic bodies; necrosis-adjacent brain parenchyma at the edge
Reticulin stain shows concentric perivascular reticulin rings splitting around vessels
IHC: CD20+, CD10-, BCL6+, MUM1+ (non-germinal center phenotype), BCL2+, c-MYC+ in a subset, high Ki-67
describe_en: Sections of brain show a diffusely infiltrative neoplasm composed of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies. The tumor cells show a prominent angiocentric pattern, forming concentric cuffs around vessels, and a reticulin stain highlights concentric perivascular layering of reticulin fibers. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells are positive for CD20, BCL6, MUM1 and BCL2, negative for CD10, show c-MYC expression in a subset of cells and have a high Ki-67 proliferation index. Findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system, non-germinal center B-cell type, pending exclusion of systemic disease.

ddx.dx: Secondary CNS involvement by systemic DLBCL
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation requires staging to exclude systemic disease.
Glioblastoma shows GFAP-positive pleomorphic glial cells with microvascular proliferation and palisading necrosis and is CD20/CD45-negative.
Metastases form cohesive nests and are keratin- or SOX10/S100-positive and CD20-negative.
Immunodeficiency-associated or LYG lesions have a polymorphous background with angiodestruction, necrosis and EBER-positive B cells.

stain: H&E; reticulin; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL6, MUM1, BCL2, MYC, Ki67
